name: Split PDF
desc: Extract pages, remove pages or split a PDF into separate files
seoTitle: Split PDF: Extract or Remove Pages Online
seoDescription: Split a PDF online for free. Extract pages, remove pages, or split into single pages or chunks as a ZIP. Files stay on your device.
intro: Pull out just the pages you need, remove the ones you don't, or break a PDF into separate files. Enter page numbers like 1-3, 5, 8-10, or split every page or every few pages into a ZIP.
steps: Drop a PDF into the box.
Choose to extract pages, remove pages, or split into separate files.
Click the button and download the result.

faq.q: How do I write the page numbers?
faq.a: Use commas and dashes: 1-3, 5, 8-10 means pages 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9 and 10.

faq.q: Can I split every page into its own file?
faq.a: Yes. Choose 'Split into separate files' and set 1 page per file. You get a ZIP of single-page PDFs.
